version_tested: Nuxt 4.5.2 (Nitro 2.13.4, Vite 8.3.1, Vue 3.5.43) via nuxi 3.37.0 init, node v24.20.0
output_dir: .output/public/ (from `nuxt generate`; plain `nuxt build` emits no page HTML here)
file_to_url: strip .output/public/ prefix, strip trailing 'index.html', ensure leading slash (e.g. .output/public/blog/hello-world/index.html -> /blog/hello-world/, .output/public/index.html -> /)
second_source_of_truth: build log prerendered-route list ('[nitro] Prerendered N routes'), minus /200.html and /404.html fallbacks and _payload.json entries
discrepancy_fixed: naive '**/*.html' count gave 3 (index.html + 200.html + 404.html) against a build-log truth of 1 real page; fixed by excluding the 200.html/404.html SPA fallbacks
gotchas: nuxt build (default SSR) emits zero HTML pages in .output/public — only _nuxt/ assets, favicon.ico, robots.txt; file-based route enumeration requires `nuxt generate` (nitro static preset), and the pages live in the public/ tree, not server/
200.html and 404.html are SPA fallbacks, not pages — a naive **/*.html count overcounts the starter 3-to-1

the prerender crawler only discovers linked routes: unlinked static pages (e.g. /about with no inbound links) get no HTML file at all unless listed in nitro.prerender.routes — the static page set is config+crawl-driven, not purely file-driven
dynamic routes like pages/blog/[slug].vue never map 1:1 to an output file; only concrete parametrized paths listed in nitro.prerender.routes (or reached by the crawler) are emitted
one _payload.json is emitted per prerendered route (plus ?_b= cache-busted variants that are skipped on write), so any json-based page rule would wildly overcount
prerendered pages use directory style (about/index.html), never about.html
with no pages/ directory, app.vue alone still yields exactly one prerendered route '/'
